review.note: Retracted in M22: the NATO training mission in Afghanistan, from January 2015 to 2021, to which Portugal contributed a small contingent. It is an act of the alliance and not of Portugal, and the atlas holds nothing of the Portuguese armed forces after 1974 for a contribution to attach to.

title: Resolute Support Mission
summary: Wikidata item Q18651204, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "NATO-led training, advisory, assistance, and counter-terror mission in the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan (2015–2021)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
